output.sql: SELECT order_month, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue_eur FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue = true AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month;
output.explanation: Revenue is net_revenue of completed orders only (is_revenue = true), so cancelled, returned and open orders are excluded. Shipping fees are not in net_revenue. Orders are filtered to order_date in 2025 and grouped by order_month, which is the first day of each month, so the rows come out in calendar order. Amounts are rounded to 2 decimals.
